_comment: All narrative text. This game is a fictional retelling inspired by the Kerala legend of Parashurama; additions are invented and are not presented as history.

intro.title: PARASHURAMA
intro.subtitle: THE ORIGIN OF KERALA
captions: Long ago, where Kerala's green hills now rise, there was only the sea.
The old tale says a sage-warrior, Parashurama, hurled his divine axe across the waters, and the waves drew back to reveal a new land.
At last he comes to the shore, bearing a vow he cannot yet fulfil.
He reaches for the axe upon his back...
The axe is gone. Without it, the sea cannot be commanded, and the land cannot rise.
Search this mysterious shore. Find the first clue to the missing axe.
intro.disclaimer: A fictional retelling inspired by Kerala legend.

beach_marks.title: Marks in the Sand
beach_marks.body:
Two deep grooves cut across the sand, as if something heavy and sharp was dragged ashore and hauled inland. Beside them, footprints - too light for a warrior's.

Whoever took the axe went toward the whispering forest to the north-west.

tree_mark.title: The Marked Tree
tree_mark.body:
Beneath the moss, a spiral sigil glows in the bark. As Parashurama's palm rests on it, the vines to the north rustle and draw apart.

A forgotten path is revealed, lit by small lamps that no one remembers lighting.

tree_locked.title: A Strange Carving
tree_locked.body: An old sigil is carved into this tree. You feel it matters, but you do not yet know why. Perhaps the trail ahead holds answers.

fragment_1.title: Inscription Fragment I
fragment_1.body:
A shard of carved stone. The worn script reads:

"First came the SEA, that gave and took away."

fragment_2.title: Inscription Fragment II
fragment_2.body:
A second shard, warm to the touch:

"Then the FOREST, that grew and kept its secrets."

fragment_3.title: Inscription Fragment III
fragment_3.body:
The last shard hums softly:

"Last the MOUNTAIN, that watched all and forgot nothing."

fragment_locked.title: Fallen Stone
fragment_locked.body: Carved fragments lie here, but you cannot yet tell what they are part of.

tablet_empty.title: The Great Tablet
tablet_empty.body: A vast tablet, its inscription shattered. Pieces of it must lie scattered across this place.

tablet_partial.title: The Great Tablet
tablet_partial.body: Some lines are restored, but the inscription is still incomplete:

tablet_full.title: The Great Tablet
tablet_full.body:
The inscription is whole:

First the SEA.
Then the FOREST.
Last the MOUNTAIN.

Three pillars wait. Set each to its truth, in that order, from west to east.

pillars_dormant.title: Dormant Pillar
pillars_dormant.body: The pillar is cold and silent. The inscription must be understood first.

final_clue.title: The Carved Relief
final_clue.body:
On the altar, a relief glows: a figure carrying an axe, climbing toward vast, mist-wrapped mountains, followed by a line of lamps.

Below it, the words: "Not lost, but carried. Where the clouds drink the forests, the Keeper waits."

Whoever took the axe did so deliberately - and took it east, toward the high mountains.

phase_complete.title: PHASE 1 - THE LOST AXE
phase_complete.subtitle:
Phase 2 awaits beyond the mountains: dense forests, rivers and hidden caves.
You may keep exploring.

tablet_lines: First came the SEA, that gave and took away.
Then the FOREST, that grew and kept its secrets.
Last the MOUNTAIN, that watched all and forgot nothing.
